messages:
sam: Heads-up — I’m doing the evening handoff at 19:30 PST. Leaving two open incidents (INC-402, INC-409). Quick 10-min triage at 19:40 to sync?
maya: I can make 19:40. @lina can you cover escalation while you’re on call? :raised_hand:
lina: Yup, available for escalation until 22:00 PST.
alex: Quick agenda suggestion: 1) current impact for each incident, 2) any immediate mitigations, 3) who owns follow-ups. Keep it short.
chris: +1 to the agenda. Need to keep it to 10 mins — deploy on my side at 20:00.
oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation today: sam -> lina at 19:30. Join triage: https://zoom.company/triage-19-40 (auto-created)
maya: Posting a tiny handoff snippet so the triage can be focused:
```
Handoff checklist:
- Running incidents: INC-402 (DB timeout spikes), INC-409 (model-serving 5xxs)
- Recent deploys: model-service v2.1 promoted at 18:45
- Immediate mitigations: scale replicas, enable request backpressure, rollback route if needed
- Logs/dashboards: logs @ /var/log/inference, infra dashboard /dash/infra, traces /traces/model
- PRs in flight: #382 (proxy backpressure), #387 (rate-limiter config)
```
sam: Added context — INC-409 seems correlated with 1.2MB request bodies. Workaround: enable proxy backpressure; PR #382 is the fix but not merged yet.
lina: I’ll take INC-409 during my oncall window. If it escalates to SEV2, ping @alex and @chris immediately.
alex: I’ll standby for escalations until 20:30. If we need an infra rollback I can coordinate.
maya: I’ll take notes in the incident threads and post summary after the call. Can someone drop the short agenda in the calendar invite?
chris: Dropping it now. Calendar updated with 19:40-19:50 triage, zoom link + agenda.
sam: Thanks — starting the handoff in 5. :thumbsup:
maya: Appreciate it, everyone. See you on the call. :wave:
